provenance: Rendered by moycore. Confirmed pixel-identical on all core scenes by two other implementations: the reference console's own rasterizer (conformance/parity.py) and the shipped WebAssembly player's JavaScript replayer (conformance/player.mjs), the tiebreaker SPEC.md 11 names.

scenes.name: primitives
scenes.note:
Every core drawing verb (SPEC.md 6) at a size where the
rasterization is visible, plus the degenerate cases: a 1x1
rect, r=0 and r=1 circles, zero-size rects.

scenes.name: edges
scenes.note:
Clipping. Every shape hangs off an edge; a host that clamps
instead of clipping, or wraps a row, fails here and nowhere else.

scenes.name: text
scenes.note:
The whole printable range (SPEC.md 6), then bytes outside it,
which must draw nothing and still advance 8px.

scenes.name: text_bytes
scenes.note:
Bytes outside 0x20-0x7F, which draw nothing and still advance
8px. SPEC.md 6: print walks BYTES, so a two-byte UTF-8
character takes two cells, not one.

scenes.name: camera_clip
scenes.note:
camera and clip TOGETHER. clip is screen space, applied
after the camera offset -- an implementation that clips in
world space passes both features separately and fails this.

scenes.name: pal_palt
scenes.note:
Draw-time remap and sprite transparency, including the case
where both are active. pal must not touch pixels already drawn.

scenes.name: sprites
scenes.note:
Flips, integer scales, colorkeys, out-of-range tile ids, and
sprites under camera and clip.

scenes.name: tilemap
scenes.note:
map() regions, screen offsets, scale, colorkey, camera, clip,
and a region starting outside the map.

scenes.name: provisional
scenes.note:
SPEC.md 6.1 verbs. NOT part of conformance -- SPEC.md 11
excludes 6.1 until its promotion gates clear. Kept so the
golden already exists when they do.

scenes.name: provisional_tline
scenes.note:
SPEC.md 6.1 tline: line()'s pixels, texture-stepped
across the map in 16.16 fixed point. Excluded like
`provisional`, and separate so a host with tri/sspr
but no tline fails one scene, not both.
